worldcombat.skill.risingvoltage.summary: Stamps the ground to drive charge into it; the current races to the point locked in when the move fired and a column erupts upward there. On ground carrying the electric-terrain charge the column is doubled, thicker and taller, and every non-ally inside is pierced. The base no longer drifts with the target.
worldcombat.skill.risingvoltage.use.0: Punish a foe standing on electric terrain
worldcombat.skill.risingvoltage.use.1: Raise a column of electricity at a locked point from range
worldcombat.skill.risingvoltage.use.2: Pierce a cluster gathered at the impact point
worldcombat.skill.risingvoltage.descript: Deals about %1$s special damage to each enemy inside the rising column; an enemy whose ground carries the electric-terrain charge takes double — figured separately for each target.

The current crawls up to %1$s blocks to the point at about %2$s blocks/tick, and only then does the column rise there; the point is locked when the move fires, so the column rises there even if the target leaves — and an empty cast still raises a column.
The column has a radius of %1$s blocks and a height of %2$s blocks, and every non-ally inside takes one hit.
worldcombat.skill.risingvoltage.overchar: Overcharge mode: power x1.2 and a thicker, taller column, but range x0.85, +3 ticks windup and +8 ticks cooldown.
Steady mode: farther, cheaper windup and cooldown, with a thinner column.
worldcombat.skill.risingvoltage.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s windup it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.risingvoltage.growth.0: From level %1$s the column power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.risingvoltage.growth.1: From level %1$s power rises to %2$s and the column grows thicker.
worldcombat.skill.risingvoltage.preferen: On (overcharge): power x1.2 and a thicker, taller column, but range x0.85, +3 ticks windup and +8 ticks cooldown, good for punching through foes on charged ground. Off (steady, default): farther, faster and cheaper, good for opening from range.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values ignite the ground from farther away.

On: put targets whose ground carries the electric-terrain charge first, because the column is doubled on them, and also favour clustered or standing targets over fast sideways movers; off: rank it as an ordinary ranged attack.
